company.name: Weave
company.shortDescription: Weave is a modern point of sale system focused on compliance and security.
company.description: Weave is a modern point of sale system focused on compliance and security. They solve the big data issue in the industry by offering dispensaries an analytics tool that gathers data in realtime from POS systems and visualizes transactional, inventory, and market data. For example, for inventory data, they display total inventory category breakdown, product turnover rates, and product flow over time.  Their platform provides visibility to suppliers to see where their SKUS are in retailers and allows retailers to manage all their inventory in realtime with the power of analytics.
